profileStorage.meaning: manualProfile inventory and GIS inspection stored in sources.inspection on retain. profile(row,scope) reads stored inventory and adds current source/workspace pins; never reparses original bytes on read. validate checks byte hash and compiles that same stored profile.
profileStorage.implication: New retained sources get unit/facts. Old profiles keep their stored degree/unit and fingerprint, absent integerIdEligible means unestablished. Missing-unit GIS inspection can default only EPSG:4326. No profile/validate edit needed if integer facts are stored by inspection at retain.

rawTokens.choice: Python json.loads parse_int callback retains literal token on an int subclass; parse_float keeps floats. Publish optional integerIdEligible for each field and featureIntegerIdEligible for top-level IDs. Reject -0 by its token, not value; 007 is invalid JSON and inspection refuses it.
rawTokens.why: No new JSON lexer. Plain safe integer tokens parse as Python ints and JavaScript safe integers; str(raw_key) and JavaScript decimal spelling equal token. Fractions/exponents/negative zero cannot receive eligibility. Profile stores the inspection fact bound to original hash; fingerprint excludes eligibility facts.

memory.exactQuery: SELECT body FROM usp_mapping_recipes WHERE state IN ('approved','executed') AND body->'approval'->>'subject'=$1 AND body->'plan'->'source'->>'schemaFingerprint'=$2 ORDER BY body->'approval'->>'at' DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
memory.existingRefusals: memoryPlan refuses absent/nonapproved/wrong-officer/different-fingerprint receipts, invalid plan schema, and compileMapping 422 (identity not complete unique, bad fields/kind/height). Approval never transferred.
memory.fallback: At most newest 50 owned approved/executed map receipts joined to their stored old manualProfile. Test containment before temporary repin of remembered source fingerprint, allowing unchanged memoryPlan to compile against current source.
